description:
Inspired by the steep, remote rock walls of southern Jordan, the new Wadi Rum Collection includes feature-packed pieces that fit in just as nicely on the crux of a climb as they do in the director's chair. Purpose-built for climbing and detailed for trail-to-town versatility, the Wadi Rum Pants and Shorts use a durable Cordura nylon, spandex, and cotton blend to match the real-world ruggedness of the Middle Eastern routes from which it was named. A gusseted crotch adds extra mobility, while a standard fit and lightweight construction keeps the wearer cool and comfortable with whatever the next pitch throws their way.

Diseñado específicamente para la escalada y detallado para la versatilidad del camino a la ciudad, los pantalones y pantalones cortos Wadi Rum utilizan una mezcla de nailon Cordura, spandex y algodón duradero para que coincida con la robustez del mundo real de las rutas de Oriente Medio desde las que fue nombrado. Una entrepierna reforzada añade movilidad adicional, mientras que un ajuste estándar y construcción ligera mantiene al usuario fresco y cómodo con lo que sea que el siguiente tono lance su camino.

Inspiriert von den steilen, abgelegenen Felswänden des Südjordaniens, enthält die neue Wadi Rum Kollektion funktionsreiche Teile, die genau so schön auf den Mittelpunkt eines Aufstiegs passen wie im Regisseurstuhl. Inspirada nas paredes de rochas remotas e íngremes do sul de Jordan, a nova coleção Wadi Rum inclui peças que se encaixam tão bem no ponto de uma escalada quanto na cadeira do diretor. USAGE TIPS

The airless pump uses an advanced technology to dispense its contents. Instead of the traditional style pump & straw which pushes air into the container to force product outward the airless dispenser uses the concept of vacuum & piston. When the pump is pressed a piston on the bottom of the container pushes the product upward and out of the top. This process avoids contaminating the product with air while minimizing contamination and spoilage. You do need to initially fill your jar to the top with the desired product to create the vacuum. The 6 jar set comes empty & ready for you to fill and re-fill with your favorite products for travel and for creating your own unique serums and lotion blends. Hand wash to re-use. The comprehensive dart storage package is here with the Casemaster Pro Nine Dart Leatherette Dart Case! Constructed from steadfast, tough leatherette around a hard resin shell, the Pro combines both enduring strength of materials with easy-to-carry portability for a complete package. The Pro packs enough storage to suit the most serious darters. The prized possession of any darter is their darts, and the Pro can store nine of them, three complete sets! Whether you’re carrying extras to lend out or you’ve got to have the right dart for the situation, we’ve got you covered. Each dart is locked into place with a solid foam inserts to prevent the darts from moving, which could cause breakage. With plenty of space at either end of the case, you won’t have to fold down your flights, leading to longer lifespans and a truer flight path. Both steel tip darts and soft tip darts will fit nicely into this stylish case. In addition to dart storage, the Pro can hold an armory’s worth of dart supplies to keep you on target and your darts in top form. With fifteen pockets for extra flights, you’ll never be without replacements. The pieces that truly set the Casemaster Pro apart are the plastic storage containers and accessory tubes, with separate lids, to sort out your spare tips and any other smaller accessories you need to bring out to darting events. This great looking durable case is backed by GLD Products’ 90 day guarantee, should something go wrong.
